name: Black Mountain Home & Accents
addr: 120 W State St, Black Mountain, NC 28711
hours: Mon 10:30 AM–4:30 PM; Tue 10:30 AM–4:30 PM; Wed 10:30 AM–4:30 PM; Thu 10:30 AM–4:30 PM; Fri 10:30 AM–5 PM; Sat 10:30 AM–5 PM; Sun 12–4 PM

reviews.t: I love the store just wish you sold more local items produced by artist and less mass produced items. Great store, friendly people.

This store is an absolute gem! If you’re looking for unique, locally made home accents, this is the place to go. The craftsmanship and quality of the items are outstanding, and you can really see the love and creativity that go into each piece. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, making the shopping experience even better. Whether you're a local or just visiting, this shop is a must-stop for anyone who appreciates beautiful, handcrafted decor. Highly recommend!
This is the only place I buy my bedding at. Top quality quilts and best of all its family owned. I would have more than 5 stars but that's all it'll let me give.

Wonderful little store in the beautiful town of Black Mountain, NC! The owners are very kind folks and a pleasure doing business with! My wife found some goodies for a nice price (dough bowl and tin tub)! Owners were so very friendly in this paranoid Covid atmosphere. Will definitely return if we make it back up to Asheville’s best kept secret, Black Mountain! Thank you!

Love this quaint shop! Adorable quilts, especially the baby and kid ones! They even have Habersham Candle Company products which are totally awesome. The owners are so friendly and sweet!! So glad we stopped in. Thanks for the hospitality!!

Wonderful store with very helpful and kind owners, Birdie and Bill. We found the perfect quilt for a gift along with a very unique handmade wooden vase and placemats. Stop in and take your time. There are unique items through the whole store. Don't let the size of the store fool you.

My husband and I had a great trip to Asheville. I wanted to bring a quilt back for my parents and for myself. Unfortunately when we walked into Black Mountain Quilts no one provided any type of assistance. To be fair when we walked in the woman was speaking to someone. I figured she would greet us once she was done but nothing. We walked right by the store clerk and she just looked and stared at us. So my husband said since you won’t speak I guess I will. She just laughed. So at that point I was ready to go. I found 1 quilt I liked but I hate to give money to an establishment that didn’t even want to provide any service.
Excellent selection of cool mountain accessories paired with outstanding customer service.
Quilt shop with some home decor and nicknacks.
Such cute gift items and home decor. One of my favorite places in town.
